full_page.content:
19.45, August
RETREAT - Wednesday - IV Conference
After all if God has given such striking manifestations for us all during our temporal existence of His love for us, why not leave death to him too. Why not, as often as we think of it, just say, "Thank you Jesus ahead of time for the death ahead of me. That is your business."
Thursday
I Conf.
Joy and Happiness in Religion Contrasted to Enjoyment and Pleasure.
The latter accidental, shallo, skin-deep of the senses. The former ... pertaining to the intelect and the will and affecting the soul - permiates the immortal soul.
Relation between penance (of yesterday) and the subject To-day is like "Cause and effect .... Penance fostering hope - hope the very soul of happiness here on the pilgrimage to our eternal destiny.
II
Apostolate of spreading the Kingdom of Jesus Christ - propaga- ting his doctrine. This by being what we profess to be - fol- lowers of Jesus Christ and Children of His "Herald- of The - Great-King, Francis.
In other words by striving to be real Franciscans - Capuchin - Franciscans. 2ndly if we be priests, by appreciating the privi- lege of preaching the word of God by preparing the sermons a- signed to us.
But this latter follows quite a little as natural effect of the former; "Charity beginning at home. i. e. in our efforts in be- ing converted ourselves.
III Conference
"A Light on a candle-stick can not be hid"
Let your light shine before men; that seeing your good works they may glorify you Father Who is in Heaven."
Every Religious, worthy the name, is as a lited candle that can not be hid ...... gentle, patient, humble, forbearing, accomodat- ing moderate and modest in all things.
